record.notes: A normative document of the Digital Society Promotion Standard Guidelines that ministries must follow; the Digital Agency prepared it with METI, MIC and others. The first edition of 27 May 2025 covered text-generating AI, applied in full to systems procured or used from fiscal year 2026 (令和8年度) and replaced the government's agreement on the business use of generative AI such as ChatGPT (version 2.1). Version 2.0, decided on 12 June 2026, came into effect on 1 September 2026, with the CAIO measures to be set by 30 June 2026 and the wider scope of the governance framework applying from 1 July 2026. It widened the generative AI covered, revised the high-risk criteria, referred to the AI Promotion Act, the AI Basic Plan and the Guideline for Ensuring the Appropriateness of Research & Development and Utilization of AI-Related Technology, and added measures for AI agents that users create, major model updates and intellectual property. Systems handling specially designated secrets or security-sensitive information are excluded; independent administrative agencies and designated corporations are expected to follow it.

They confirm the title, the Japanese title, the issuer, the identifier, the dates, the normative status, the effective date of 1 September 2026 and the content; the summary is checked against the Japanese text of version 2.0, with terms as the government's translation renders them. official_url now points to the news page on version 2.0, because the page on the first decision says it is not the latest version. judgment.status_reasoning: DS-920 is a Normative document of the Digital Society Promotion Standard Guidelines, rules to be adhered to for government information systems, so it binds ministries as government rules. Version 2.0, decided on 12 June 2026, came into effect on 1 September 2026 under its supplementary provisions ('この決定の内容は、2026 年（令和８年）９月１日から施行する'); today, 18 October 2026, is after that date. The DS-920 entry (copy of 18 Oct 2026) lists 12 June 2026 as the latest revision. 'In force' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2025-05-27 is the first decision (revision history, first-edition cover, news pages). date_last_updated 2026-06-12 is version 2.0 (DS-920 entry, cover, news page, translation). date_in_force stays null: the first edition gave application by fiscal year (in part from fiscal year 2025, in full from fiscal year 2026), and 1 September 2026 is the commencement of version 2.0, recorded in notes rather than as the instrument's entry into force.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Binding government-wide rules on the procurement and use of generative AI, with risk classification and governance; in scope with no note.
